title: The 5 Levels of
<g>AI in Business</g>
subtitle: Most teams stop at level 1. The value starts at 3.

cards.title: Chat
cards.body: You ask, it answers, you copy it over.

cards.title: Saved prompts
cards.body: The same good question, kept and reused.

cards.title: Workflows
cards.body: Steps that run on their own, start to finish.

cards.title: AI team
cards.body: Rooms that draft real work for you to approve.

cards.title: Operating system
cards.body: Every room, one memory, one inbox, one loop.
